name: Render UI
description: Render a safe, interactive declarative UI in the chat. Use for dashboards, forms, tables, charts, diagrams, and structured interactive results. For a full custom app with arbitrary HTML/JS, save an HTML artifact instead.

function.name: render_ui
function.description: Render an interactive UI tree in the chat. The tree is declarative JSON, not HTML or JavaScript. Supported nodes: text, markdown, card, stack, grid, badge, divider, table, chart, mermaid, image, link, input, select, button. Use stable ui_id values and mode=patch only when updating an existing UI. Every input/select/button needs an id and action; actions are sent back to you as structured UI action messages. Use save_artifact for arbitrary HTML/JS mini-apps.

mode.description: replace renders the tree; patch reserves the id for future updates.

tree.description: Root declarative UI node. Containers use children; table uses columns/rows; chart uses data [{label,value}].
